articles.title: Scientists built a floating farm using seawater; three crops topped 80% germination in tests
articles.description: Scientists have developed a floating farm which uses sunlight to desalinate seawater. The double-layered vertical solar sea farm design integrates evaporation and cultivation chambers efficiently. Researchers tested six units in artificial seawater, demonstrating practical cultivation potential. This technology offers a promising route for marine agriculture and efficient water use.

articles.description: A 38-year-old earning Rs 3.2 lakh monthly was saving only Rs 25,000, CA Paaras Gangwal revealed on X.
